messages:
Tom H: Quick heads-up — planning a traffic heatmap tilt for edge routing to push ~12% -> 35% to eu-region for model-v2. Window: 03:00–03:20 UTC tomorrow. Who can own the deploy + smoke?
Anya P: I can own the deploy. I’ll be on call for that window. plan: apply routing policy change, verify curl health, then watch perf dashboards.
Kevin L: I’ll take SRE watch. Can we drop DNS TTL to 30s ~10m before the window so rollback is faster?
Tom H: Yes, good call. Can we get that done at 02:50 UTC?
Kevin L: Yep. I’ll update DNS TTL and post when done.
SRE-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice created: heatmap-tilt-eu-modelv2, start=2026-03-18T03:00:00Z, end=2026-03-18T03:20:00Z. Alerts: edge-rollout-eu-5xx, edge-latency-eu-p90.
Julia O: Reminder: invalidate the prefix cache after heavy tilt. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-rollout — follow steps 2/3/4 (cache invalidate, kv-cache sync, spike-protection).
Tom H: Smoke checks I’ll run right after applying change:```bash
# basic health
curl -sS -I https://inference-eu.redwood.ai/health | head -n1
# quick perf probe
ab -n 50 -c 5 https://inference-eu.redwood.ai/predict
```
Oliver M: Rollback command (infractl):```bash
infractl traffic set-weight --route edge-eu --model model-v2 --weight 0 --policy fallback
# quick alternative (legacy): infractl route swap --from eu:tilt --to eu:baseline
```
Anya P: Operational thresholds we agreed: if 5xx > 2% over a 5m window OR p95 latency increases > 40% for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> immediate rollback. Also keep an eye on cache hit rate.
Kevin L: I’ll create a dashboard and temp alert group now: name=edge-rollout-eu-monitor. I’ll mute noisy non-actionable alerts.
Tom H: Can someone own smoke automation? I can run the commands but would prefer a quick script so we can reproduce.
Julia O: I’ll drop a small smoke script in the runbook shortly (curl + sample payloads + synthetic latency probes).
Kevin L: TTL lowered to 30s now (02:51 UTC). I also validated zone change propagated to public resolvers.
Anya P: Great. I’ll start the tilt at 03:00 and post progress updates. Steps: 1) ramp to 12% -> validate 5m 2) ramp to 25% -> validate 5m 3) ramp to 35% hold 5m.
Tom H: Note: temporary traffic policy tag = heatmap-tilt-2026-03-18, add to logs for filtering.
SRE-bot: Alert subscription updated: edge-rollout-eu-monitor -> slack:#eng oncall, pager: oncall-rotation.
Oliver M: I’ll be ready to run rollback if Kevin signals. I’ll keep infractl session open.
Anya P: Starting now: will post at each step. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
